text: Bitcoin's modest 1% decline alongside Ethereum's steeper 2.4% drop suggests mild profit-taking in a market still tilted toward greed, with the Fear & Greed index at 71 and climbing 10 points over the week. Bitcoin's dominance at 59% indicates strength in the major—traders aren't fleeing to altcoins—while the $75B daily volume is healthy enough to absorb the selling pressure. Overall, sentiment remains constructive despite the pullback, with no signs of panic or capitulation among either BTC or ETH holders.
